answer: Locks are written down in delta, expire in sparrow, and mesa lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 158 aliases hence needs 112 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3673 identities would post 1346 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
